Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for the draft — appreciate the focus. We reviewed internally and attached a PDF with tracked redlines (redline_emeraldtech_v2.pdf). High level:

- Customer count: we onboarded 11 customers on the new flow, not 12 (page 2). Please correct.
- Cost reduction: the 38% in your draft is an aggregate estimate; our finance team reports 37% across billed customers — can you update to 37% and note it’s an average?
- Timeline: the rollout to EU region started two weeks earlier than listed (mid-Jan).
- Quote: I suggest tweaking Tom’s quote to remove the phrase "immediate ROI" — we prefer "measurable ROI within two billing cycles."

Also, we’re happy to provide a short one-paragraph customer blurb about architecture (we use a multi-region VPC setup). If you want that, I can loop in our eng lead.

Please send the revised wording for the quote once you’ve updated it so Tom can do a final sign-off.

Aisha
Head of Professional Services
EmeraldTech

Thanks for the ping — I reviewed Aisha's redlines and the proposed quote language. Legal is fine with the phrasing "measurable ROI within two billing cycles" as long as we don't include guaranteed dollar savings or an exact timeline tied to all customers. Recommended final quote:

"Partnering with Redwood Inference delivered measurable ROI within two billing cycles, improving throughput and reducing observable operating costs by ~37% across our production tenants."

Please avoid presenting the 37% as a guaranteed outcome for all customers; include a parenthetical note: "(average observed in EmeraldTech pilot)."

Marissa — you can proceed with the marketing edit. Aisha — we can attach a short marketing release; I’ve made a couple of minor tweaks to the release draft and uploaded internally as marketing_release_draft.pdf. If EmeraldTech is comfortable signing, we can route via DocuSign: https://na1.docusign.net/Signing/?s=emerald-release-2026
